1.o: When Shadow Moon is released from prison early after the death of his wife, he meets Mr. Wednesday and is recruited as his bodyguard. Shadow discovers that this may be more than he bargained for.

2.o: As Mr. Wednesday begins recruitment for the coming battle, Shadow Moon travels with him to Chicago and agrees to a very high stakes game of checkers with the old Slavic god, Czernobog.

3.o: Shadow questions the terms of his employment when Mr. Wednesday informs him of his plan to rob a bank (because, naturally, every army needs a source of funding). And just when Shadow thought his life couldn’t get any more complicated, he returns to his motel room to a surprising discovery.

4.o: Alternating between the past and the present, Laura’s life and death are explored—how she met Shadow, how she died, and how exactly she came to be sitting on the edge of his motel room bed.

5.o: Trying to work things out with his dead and unfaithful wife, Shadow's emotional reunion is interrupted when he and Mr. Wednesday are kidnapped by the New Gods.

6.o: On the run after the New Gods' show of force, Shadow and Mr. Wednesday seek safe haven with one of Mr. Wednesday's oldest friends, Vulcan, God of the Fire and the Forge.

7.o: Her brief reunion with Shadow over far too quickly, Laura turns to an unlikely travel companion to find her way back to life, and back to Shadow. Mad Sweeney's long, winding, and often tragic past is explored.

8.o: On the eve of war, Mr. Wednesday must recruit one more Old God: Ostara, ne Easter, Goddess of the Dawn, but winning her over will require making a good impression, and that is where Mr. Nancy comes in.

1.o: Following the epic showdown at Easter's party, Mr. Wednesday continues his quest to pitch the case for war to the Old Gods. Meanwhile, Mr. World plans revenge and Technical Boy goes on the hunt for Media.

2.o: Promising vengeance for the death of a beloved old god, Mr. Wednesday begins preparation for a great battle. Meanwhile Laura and Mad Sweeney chase Shadow’s diminishing light after his disappears. The Jinn and Salim set out to retrieve the Gungnir spear, and Shadow encounters an associate of Mr. World.

3.o: As he is tracked by Mr. World, Shadow makes his way to Cairo, thanks to a ride from Sam Black Crow. Mr. Wednesday slyly gains Laura’s help in forging an alliance with a powerful god. Mr. World introduces Technical Boy to New Media and assigns them a very important task.

4.o: While Shadow and Mr. Wednesday take a secret meeting in St. Louis, Bilquis arrives at the funeral home in Cairo, where she engages in a debate with Mr. Nancy and Mr. Ibis. Laura rejoins Mad Sweeney, and Tech Boy pays a visit to his first worshipper.

5.o: Shadow learns the ways of the dead with the help of Mr. Ibis and Mr. Nancy. In New Orleans, Mad Sweeney introduces Laura to old friends who share their world of voodoo healing. Mr. Wednesday embarks on a road trip with Salim and the Jinn.

6.o: Shadow and Mr. Wednesday seek out Dvalin to repair the Gungnir spear. But before the dwarf is able to etch the runes of war, he requires a powerful artifact in exchange. On the journey, Wednesday tells Shadow the story of Donar the Great.

7.o: In Cairo, Mr. Wednesday entrusts Shadow with the Gungnir spear. Mad Sweeney recalls his journey through the ages as he awaits his promised battle. Once again, he warns Shadow about Wednesday. Meanwhile, Laura receives sage advice from Mama-Ji.

8.o: Shadow is tormented by recent events and Wednesday has disappeared. Those that remain witness the power of New Media as she is unleashed, and the nation is enveloped in a state of panic brought on by Mr. World.

1.o: After months apart, Wednesday reappears in Shadow's life, resolved to drag him back into his war effort. A meeting with the god Wisakedjak leaves Shadow with a prophecy about his destiny.

2.o: Shadow explores his oddly welcoming new town before heading to Chicago for a gathering of the Old Gods on Koliada. Wednesday reconnects with his oldest friend.

3.o: As the search for the missing girl continues, Shadow dreams of Bilquis. Wednesday discovers the whereabouts of his old love, the Greek goddess Demeter, and resolves to free her from the grip of an unscrupulous antagonist.

4.o: Shadow and Technical Boy team up to search for Bilquis, who finds herself captive and in the midst of a crisis of identity. Wednesday visits the local chapter of notorious biker gang Lords of Valhalla.

5.o: Shadow explores notions of purpose, destiny and identity with a newly enlightened Bilquis. Elsewhere, Technical Boy struggles with an identity crisis of his own. Wednesday asks Shadow to assist in a new con.

6.o: Despite his past following him to Lakeside, Shadow makes himself at home and builds relationships within the town. Laura and Salim continue to hunt for Wednesday, who attempts one final gambit to win over Demeter.

7.o: In Lakeside, Shadow grows closer with Marguerite and uncovers the surprising truth behind a local crime spree. Wednesday makes his own shocking discovery. Laura and Salim negotiate with the enemy of their enemy.

8.o: Laura and Salim's quest forces them outside of their comfort zones as they learn to let go of their pasts. Shadow is surprised by a new side of Wednesday, while Technical Boy attempts to escape the prison of his own mind.

9.o: Shadow has to decide the price he's willing to pay for his idyllic Lakeside life. As Laura and her new ally close in on her target, Wednesday has to persuade Czernobog that it's time to make peace with their enemies.

10.o: Teetering on the edge of war and peace, the gods gather to mourn a loss. Bilquis' divine journey brings her to an unexpected revelation, while Shadow finally embraces destiny.

1.o: In this series opener, the US Secretary of State tries to protect a shocking family secret all the while dealing with an Iranian hostage crisis.

2.o: Douglas discovers Elaine has plans to run for office again as T.J. revisits his old habits and hits rock bottom. Elaine has Bud negotiate for the lives of Iranian hostages, placing him back into the spotlight.

3.o: Elaine makes an announcement to her family. The Hammond men visit a pollster during an impromptu fishing trip. Garcetti enacts a plan that puts Elaine in conflict with her longtime mentor. Susan shares her top-secret story with Alex.

4.o: T.J. recounts the events that lead up to his suicide attempt while dealing with his family's lack of interest in his club opening. Douglas struggles to cope with his betrayal and meanwhile, Elaine has a diplomatic crisis on her hands upon her return from overseas.

5.o: Elaine's attention is torn between catering to T.J. and a Chinese submarine rescue mission. She also makes a deal with Susan allowing her unlimited access to the rescue mission in exchange for her discretion about T.J.

6.o: In the Season 1 finale, Elaine's plan to resign hits a snag and her resignation letter leaks to the press. Elsewhere, Douglas confesses his betrayal and makes a rash decision; and a surprising event leaves everyone at a crossroads.

1.o: Chae Gyung lives far away from her parents, hidden away from all the commotion going on in the palace. However, she secretly goes to Hanyang and runs into Yeok, the younger brother of Yung, the King. Yung is supposed to give the throne to Yeok when he comes of age, but he doesn’t want to as the throne is the only thing that is his.

2.o: Yeok and Chae Gyung’s relationship becomes even more complicated. While traveling to meet her parents, she loses the important letter, and thinks that Yeok stole it. Furthermore, the relationship between Yeok and Yung becomes more strained as Yung finds out about a secret letter his father had left behind.

3.o: Seo Noh’s father is arrested for what Seo Noh did. Troubled by this, Yeok and Chae Gyung help him run away. Meanwhile, Su Geun receives a letter from the priest that says the Royal Family and Chae Gyung must not get involved or else face violent turmoil.

4.o: Yeok receives a severe punishment for breaking Mak Gae out of prison. Chae Gyung goes to Yung to ask for forgiveness, but instead ends up getting blamed for the crime. Chae Gyung and Yeok face the King and the ministers and find out the punishment to their mistake.

5.o: Chae Gyung runs into Yung and together they do a memorial service for both Yeok and his mother. She also runs into Yeok who was in the next room. She thinks he is a ghost who looks like Yeok.

6.o: Chae Gyung dresses up as a man to seduce a mysterious man. She believes that the man is Yeok. She and Nak Cheon spend the day together, and Nak Cheon convinces her that he is not Yeok. Yung begins to have nightmares and fears that Yeok will come back.

7.o: Chae Gyung is imprisoned for helping the thief get away. Because she was so desperate to hide his identity, Yung suspects that the thief is Yeok. Meanwhile, Myong Hye sneaks into the cell to kill Chae Gyung.

8.o: Chae Gyung is at risk of losing her life. Yeok begins to think of a way to help Chae Gyung and decides that his brother is the only one who can help. Yeok comes up with a plan to get Yung to help Chae Gyung. Meanwhile, Su Geun offers his life in the place of his daughter’s, and the ministers do all they can to keep Chae Gyung in prison.

9.o: Yung asks Yeok what he wishes to have, and he answers that he wants Chae Gyung. Meanwhile, Chae Gyung hears about the prophecy and tries to be apart from Yeok. However, Yeok is determined to marry her.

10.o: Yung gives a royal command for Yeok and Chae Gyung to get married. Im Sa Hong finds out where Yeok and his friends have been using as their headquarters and goes there. Chae Gyung gains the courage to marry Yeok despite the prophecy, and Yung realized his feelings towards Chae Gyung is love.

11.o: Yung orders Chae Gyung to become a spy. Yeok works harder to protect Chae Gyung. Meanwhile, Yung's jealousy and surveillance worsen as they count the days until Chae Gyung and Yeok's wedding day.

12.o: Yeok and Chae Gyung finally get married. However, Yung and the people around Yung become more cautious of the two of them. While Chae Gyung tries her best to trust in Yeok, a seed of doubt begins to form when she finds out that Yeok lied about getting hurt. She decides to pay the pawn shop a visit to see if she can find anything out. Meanwhile, there is a death amongst the people around Yeok.

13.o: Chae Gyung feels betrayed and confused by Yeok after seeing traces treason at his hideout. Moreover, she decides to protect Yeok from Yung after witnessing Yung’s tyranny. It’s the beginning of their tragedy.

14.o: Chae Gyung accepts Myong Hye as her handmaiden. The Queen Dowager suspects that Chae Gyung is the woman with the secret letter and sets the date for their consummation. Meanwhile, Chae Gyung's suspicion towards Yeok continues growing. This only torments her, and she decides that it is time to come clean to him and tell him what she knows and believes.

15.o: Yeok puts everything down and spends his time with Chae Gyung. Meanwhile, Yung is having nightmares and lets his anger out on people around Chae Gyung. Yeok announces that he’ll give up on his rebellion.

16.t: The Leader of The Snail Wives
16.o: Yeok helps Shin Su Geun and decides to leave the capital with Chae Gyung. Meanwhile, Yung gives Su Geun a royal command to catch the snail wives. In the search for the snail wives, anyone who has received rice from them gets captured, tortured and put to death. Seo Noh sees innocent citizens dying due to Yung's tyranny and gets angry.

17.o: Yeok and Chae Gyung is locked up for treason. Su Geun is also ordered to stay inside and never come out. Meanwhile, Chae Gyung gets into a dangerous deal with Yung in order to save Yeok.

18.o: Yeok and Chae Gyung get to see each other for a brief moment, Yeok prepares to restore the nation. Chae Gyung couldn't decide on what to do while she was on Yung's side, but she finally makes up her mind to help Yeok. Meanwhile, Yung's obsession on Chae Gyung becomes greater.

19.o: Yeok takes the throne, but there’s a price he must pay. People surrounding him are discussing dethroning Chae Gyung from her position. Meanwhile, Yung receives a message on his way into exile that Su Geun was killed.

20.t: I Love You, I Love You, I Love You
20.o: Yeok saves Chae Gyung from being hanged. Myong Hye hands over the men who helped in the escape of Yung, and Yeok’s men capture them. The ministers tell Yeok to dispose of Chae Gyung, but he refuses. Meanwhile, Chae Gyung asks Yeok for a divorce so that people will stop dying.

1.t: Starting Today, You Are a Host!
1.o: Haruhi Fujioka, scholarship student, is immediately mistaken for a boy when she arrives at elite private school Ouran Academy. Searching for a quiet place to study, she stumbles across the Host Club, and, in an attempt to escape, accidentally breaks a ¥8 million vase. To pay back the debt, Haruhi becomes a member—needing to be "requested" by at least one hundred customers before she can leave. However, one by one the Host Club members discover her true gender; all except Tamaki, who accidentally sees her in her underwear before he gets the hint.

2.t: The Job of a High School Host!
2.o: The Host Club finds out that one of their regular customers, one of the few that skips from host to host regularly, is having trouble with her fiancé. The group then cooks up a plan to help, involving a dance, a kiss, and a big spotlight. Unfortunately, in the process, Haruhi has her first kiss; but not with the fiancé, but with the fiancée.

3.o: The time has come for the school's physical examinations, so the club must find a way to protect Haruhi's Big Secret. Their attempts fail miserably until Kyoya steps in, with a doctor who promises not to reveal her secret. Meanwhile, someone accused of attempting to "make a pass" on one of the female students, Dr Yabu (literally, Quack Doctor) is actually searching for his daughter after she and her mother left him due to financial problems. 4.o: Renge, an intense young woman obsessed with dating sims, declares herself the Host Club’s new manager! Her first order of business: give each of the Hosts a "dark side."

5.o: The twins beg to be allowed to visit Haruhi's home, but she refuses. Haruhi comments about the differences between Hikaru and Kaoru, which triggers a fight between the inseparable siblings, even making them dye their hair different colors, blue and pink, in order to be told apart. When Haruhi finally stands up to their fighting, saying "if they've never fought before, they might need help stopping," Kaoru is about to give Hikaru a cursed doll with his name written on the back - but when Haruhi steps in, he gives it to her instead. 6.t: The Grade School Host is the Naughty Type!
6.o: An elementary school brat, Shiro Takaoji, seeks help from the Host Club's King to win the heart of women, but what he doesn't say makes all the difference in how much help he gets. He attempts to run away, calling Tamaki a "fake king", and Tamaki and the others infiltrate the elementary school, discovering that Shiro has a crush on a girl who would soon be moving away. Tamaki explains to him he didn't wish to please women, but only to please one woman - the girl he has a crush on. He had joined the Classical Music Club to make her happy and play the piano with her. Mori and Haruhi separate from the rest of the group to look for him, Mori eventually carrying her due to her slowness and clumsiness. Haruhi wonders aloud about Mori's and Honey's relationship, and then twins explain that they are in fact cousins by marriage. 8.t: The Sun, the Sea, and the Host Club!
8.o: The Host Club visits the "real beach" in Okinawa upon Haruhi's request, but, Kyoya having invited customers, Haruhi is still unable to wear a swimsuit - much to the others disappointment. The twins devise a game to see who can find out what Haruhi is afraid of first, drawing Tamaki in with the explanation that only close friends show each other their weaknesses. Kyoya hypes up the competition by offering up photos of Haruhi in middle school. One accident occurred that caused a fight between the Host Club members. Kyouya, however, made Haruhi realize what her mistakes were and she eventually ap

9.t: A Challenge from Lobelia Girls' Academy!
9.o: St. Lobelia Girl's Academy's Benio Amakusa, head of the Zuka Club, chances upon Haruhi and, instantly recognizing that she is a girl, tries to convince her to join her school and her club. Convinced that Haruhi will leave them, the boys dress up as girls to show Haruhi that she "can have big brothers AND big sisters - all in one!" Haruhi reveals that she came to Ouran for a reason, and says that she was never planning to leave for Lobelia in the first place.

10.t: A Day in the Life of the Fujioka Family!
10.o: Interested in the unknown ways of a "commoner's lifestyle", the Host Club makes an unannounced appearance at Haruhi's house to meet her family and see how she lives. Tamaki realizes how independent Haruhi is and some of the reasons why.

11.o: Tamaki enlists the help of Renge in teaching Nekozawa to become the princely figure his little sister is convinced he is and help him face his fear of light, eventually leading to him saving his sister from a large, unfriendly cat, leading her to be convinced of his bravery despite the wig and cloak that he wears.

12.o: Honey gets his first cavity, and the number one rule until the cavity is fixed is no sweets. He then takes his frustration out on Mori, who is being strict on Honey, but Honey realizes that Mori was punishing himself for not telling Honey to brush his teeth twice.

13.o: Haruhi's dream about the day of her admission into Ouran High School becomes a trippy Alice in Wonderland-esque fantasy. Her friends try to tell Haruhi something important, but she only realizes it when in court. At the end of the dream, she meets her mom, who tells her to "enjoy a dream like student life." She wakes up with tears in her eyes, and sees the club dressed up in costumes that look like the ones they wore in her dream.

14.o: The ailing Newspaper Club wants to obtain an interview with the popular Host Club in order to save it from being disbanded due to the lack of public interest. Or so it seems. The newspaper club tell lies in their papers, so the club leader wants to interview the host club because he thinks that Tamaki is using his parents' power to control the popular students, and wants to tell the whole school that. Apparently he thinks of Tamaki as his mortal enemy.

15.o: During summer vacation, Haruhi gets a part-time job in a pension at Karuizawa. She feels guilty at first for not saying anything to the rest of the Host Club, until they drop in unannounced. A contest erupts when they realize there is only one remaining room at the pension. Hikaru and Kaoru win by using their brotherly love act. When Haruhi's middle school friend visits, things take a turn for the worst.

16.t: Operation Haruhi and Hikaru's First Date!
16.o: Hikaru gets jealous of Haruhi's former classmate while at the pension. Kaoru pretends to be sick for the date, and instead sets up a date for Hikaru and Haruhi to try to get Hikaru to think of other people which Tamaki does not take too well. During their date, Hikaru runs off somewhere, and a thunderstorm occurs. Worried about Haruhi, Tamaki calls Hikaru, and tells him that Haruhi is afraid of thunder, letting everyone know Haruhi's weakness. 17.o: Kyoya, half-asleep, is dragged into a commoner's department store by Tamaki and the rest of the boys, who aim to study the life of ordinary people, and therefore understand more about Haruhi - or play. Kyoya ends up meeting Haruhi there, alone, and they find it interesting how each other views their lives. Towards the end, Tamaki makes a call for a "lost child", who turns out to be Kyoya, which makes Kyoya even angrier at Tamaki than he already is.

18.o: Honey has a younger brother Yasuchika, but he has a huge grudge against his sibling. It turns out the reason for his brother's grudge is that Honey eats too many cakes, causing Yasuchika to freak out.

19.o: The girls from St. Lobelia's Zuka Club finally manage to rope Haruhi into their academy, and it is up to the Host Club boys and Ranka to save her from Benio Amakusa stealing her first kiss - until Kyouya reminds them of Haruhi's real first kiss in a previous episode. The episode ends with the Lobelia's Zuka Club chasing Haruhi around the stage, attempting to steal her second kiss.

20.o: A prequel that tells the story of how the twins were convinced to help form the club, including the "Which One is Hikaru?" game that they always played, including their past with the maid who led them to believe that no one would ever be able to tell them apart, and the cruel trick that they played on a girl in middle school.

21.t: Until the Day it Becomes a Pumpkin!
21.o: Haruhi's class has a Halloween event - The Halloween Special Fear Trial Tournament- in which groups do their best to scare the living daylights out of each other! The class rep isn't so keen on this idea, though, and enlists Haruhi to help him. Kaoru, meanwhile, contemplates a sad truth. Nekozawa decides to scare the group of Haruhi, Kaoru, Hikaru, and the class rep.

22.o: When the son of a gangster, Ritsu Kasanoda, seeks Mori for tips on how to change his scary image and gain friends, the Host Club immediately jumps at the opportunity to change his image, making many humorous results of their efforts. The members of the Host Club also frequently call him Casanova and bossa nova. However, Ritsu ends up discovering Haruhi's secret.

23.o: After Ritsu walks in on Haruhi changing, he later joins the Host Club, but as a customer. When he insists on Haruhi as his host, the other hosts get nervous and the clients get excited. Tamaki starts to realize his feelings for Haruhi, and Ritsu nearly goes insane, while Haruhi remains blissfully oblivious.

24.o: Kyoya recalls when he first meets Tamaki two years ago, and how he only became friends with him due to Tamaki being the heir to the Suou family businesses. He initially put up with Tamaki's odd requests, traveling all over Japan, but eventually snapped. From that point on, however, Kyoya could be his real self in front of Tamaki and they became true friends.

25.o: The Host Club participates in the annual school festival. Tamaki's father and grandmother turn up there. However, the arrival of Eclair Tonnerre, a woman who Tamaki was told to take care of by his grandmother, brings an unforeseen turn of events. Haruhi also learns of Tamaki's history, and his entrance into the Suoh family.

26.o: The Host Club must race against time to keep Tamaki in Japan and save the club from disbanding. However there are a few bumps along the way, as well as a wild horse ride, fighting with Ootori family police and Grand Tonnerre taking over lots of businesses. After Hikaru gets hurt, Haruhi rides the carriage and runs after Tamaki. Haruhi convinces Tamaki to return to the Host Club and reaches for his hand, but Tamaki is stopped by Eclair Tonnerre. 2.o: As KJ and Fish continue to investigate, an increasingly nervous Pete considers his options. DiAngelo goes in search of a possible witness.

3.o: While Fish pursues an elusive lead, KJ struggles to have a painful conversation with the Butlers. Pete and DiAngelo butt heads.

4.o: Latrice attempts to conjure a memory. KJ visits her father. Fish plays hardball with a witness. Pete contemplates the cost of his morals.

5.o: As cops come under suspicion, Marie receives a surprise visitor, Isaiah worries about Latrice’s stability, and Seth asks an old friend for help.

6.o: DiAngelo offers an olive branch, but it may be too late. KJ and Fish clash with stonewallers. Pete's grocery store trip doesn't go as planned.

7.o: As community outrage over Brenton's death grows, Latrice's grief takes her down a dark path. Meanwhile, KJ makes a painful confession.

8.o: KJ meets her match in court, Latrice tries to address her grief, and Isaiah struggles to accept new information about Brenton.

9.o: As the defense puts Brenton's character on trial, KJ gives a powerful opening statement and Isaiah delivers unexpected testimony.

10.o: As the trial edges toward its conclusion, KJ and Fish search for a way to hold the defense accountable and Brenton's parents prepare for what's next.

1.o: في طريقهم نحو مستعمرة فضائية، ترسل أزمة آل "روبنسون" بعنف نحو كوكب غير مألوف، حيث يكافحون للنجاة من ليلة مرعبة.

2.o: يجلب اصطدام آخر المزيد من المسافرين إلى الكوكب، فيما يعمل "آل روبنسون" على إنقاذ سفينتهم بمساعدة من رفقتهم الجديدة الغامضة.

3.o: مع العودة بالزمن، تتكشف أدلة عن ماضي د. "سميث". ويواجه آل "روبنسون" تهديدًا جديدًا، حيث يبدأ مخزون وقود السفينة في الانخفاض، وبسرعة.

4.o: يتواصل آل "روبنسون" مع عائلة أخرى من الناجين، ويسارع "ويل" لحماية صديقه بعد أن عرفت "جودي" بما حدث على متن "ذا ريزولوت".

5.o: فيما يقوم الفريق ببناء برج لإرسال إشارة إلى "ذا ريزولوت"، تُحقق "مورين" في حالة كوكبية شاذة، ويستعد "ويل" لمحادثة قاسية مع أبيه.

6.o: تتناقش "مورين" بشأن مشاركة الآخرين ما رأته في السماء أم حجبه. أما "دون" فيقود مهمة للعثور على وقود، ويثير تواجد الآلي التوترات ضمن المجموعة.

7.o: فيما تمضي د. "سميث" قدمًا في مشروع سريّ، يجلب نشاط زلزالي الدمار عبر الكوكب، تاركًا الفريقين في مواجهة خيارات مستحيلة.

8.o: تجد "مورين" حلًّا لمشكلة الوقود، ولكن وضْع خطتها موضع التنفيذ يبدو أصعب مما كان متوقّعًا، بينما تدرك د. "سميث" أنه تمَّ اكتشاف حقيقتها.

9.o: تنطلق "جودي" للعثور على "مورين"، بينما يقود "ويل" و"بيني" حملة استكشافية في الكهوف، وتسعى د. "سميث" وراء خطة هرب جديدة.

10.o: فيما يوشك الوقت المتبقي لإقلاع "ذا ريزولوت" أن ينفد، يصارع "آل روبنسون" للخروج من الكوكب ومن قبضة د. "سميث".

1.o: بعد مضي سبعة أشهر من انعزالهم على كوكب مائي، يُقدِم "آل روبنسون" على محاولة محفوفة بالمخاطر لتشغيل سفينة "جوبيتر"، ويتعهد "ويل" بتتبع الآلي.

2.o: تُحاصَر "بيني" و"مورين" في خندق معدني غامض، في الوقت الذي يقع فيه "دون" فريسة لسمّ خطير.

3.o: تتلاشى أحلام "آل روبنسون" في اللقاء المرتقب حين يدركون وقوع كارثة ما على متن سفينة "ذا ريزولوت"، وتنتهز "سميث" الفرصة لحذف ما يدينها.

4.o: ريثما يبحث "ويل" عن أدلّة حول مصير الآلي، يذهب "جون" و"جودي" إلى الكوكب الترابي المجاور لمساعدة زملائهم على النجاة بحياتهم.

5.o: تشرع "جودي" في سباق جنوني عبر الكوكب مع تفاقم حالة "جون"، فيما تتجسّس "بيني" على "سميث" بمساعدة أحد أصدقائها القدامى.

6.o: تعلَق "بيني" و"سميث" وصديقان آخران في أروقة ضيّقة نتيجة الملوِّث سريع الانتشار، وينطلق "ويل" و"مورين" مع "أدلر" للبحث عن الآلي.

7.o: يوظّف "جون" شريكًا غير متوقّع ليساعده في تعقّب إشارة صوتية سرّية التقطتها السفينة، فيما تساور "ويل" الشكوك حول إخفاء "أدلر" لأمر ما.

8.o: فيما تقود "مورين" حركة تمرّد، يزور "هستينغس" "جون" ليقدّم له إنذارًا نهائيًا، وتحاول "بيني" إقناع "ويل" بأنّ الآلي الذي يملكه قد تغيّر.

9.o: يسارع "ويل" و"بيني" لإخفاء الآليين والتفكير في الخطوة التالية بعد ذلك، في الوقت الذي يجهّز فيه "هستينغس" العتاد لحربه ضدّ "آل روبنسون".

10.o: يؤدي انحراف مهمة إنقاذ "الفزّاعة" المفاجئ عن مسارها إلى حدوث تشويش في سفينة "ذا ريزولوت"، وتضع "جودي" خطة لإرسال سفينة إلى "ألفا سنتوري".

1.o: بعد سنة من بدء المهمّة مع أبناء "ذا ريزولوت"، تجاهد "جودي" و"بيني" و"ويل" للعثور على حاجتهم من التيتانيوم للوصول إلى "ألفا سنتوري".

2.o: فيما تبحث "جودي" عن "غرانت كيلي"، تستكشف "بيني" و"ويل" نفقًا غامضًا، وتنقّب "مورين" و"جون" و"دون" عن بقايا آلي دخيل ثانٍ على بعد سنين ضوئية.

3.o: يساعد "الفزّاعة" "مورين" و"جون" في سرقة محرّك، و تعود "جودي" إلى المخيّم بمسافرين جدد. أمّا "ويل"، فيكتشف شيئًا مذهلًا في المدينة الفضائية.

4.o: بينما يتسابق البالغون لتدمير كافّة الأدلّة المتعلّقة بموقع "ألفا سنتوري"، يستقبل أبناء "آل روبنسون" رسالة مشؤومة من الآليّ الدخيل الثاني.

5.o: بعد الاصطدام بسطح كوكب موحل، تتعارك "مورين" و"جودي" مع كائن ضخم جائع، بينما يعمل "جون" و"بيني" على تخليص الآليّ العالق.

6.o: يدرك "آل روبنسون" أمرًا مثيرًا للقلق بعد معرفة قصّة العداوة بين "دون" والآليّ الدخيل الثاني، بينما يتسلّل "ويل" في مهمّة فردية خطرة.

7.o: يسارع آل "روبنسون" لتلقّي المساعدة لأجل "ويل" ويحذّرون المستعمرين الآخرين وينشّطون نظام دفاع سرّيًا، فيما يرافق "فيجاي" "بيني" في جولة خطرة.

8.o: بينما تحتدم المعركة من أجل "ألفا سنتوري"، يخاطر آل "روبنسون" وأصدقاؤهم بكلّ شيء لإحلال السلام مرّة أخرى وتهيئة الأوضاع لبناء مستقبل أفضل.

1.o: يساعد ناثان متجر زبادي مثلج من خلال ابتكار نكهة مثيرة للجدل، ويهرع لإنقاذ محلي للبيتزا عبر ضمان وقت توصيل لا يمكن لأي منافس تحقيقه

2.o: يُطلق ناثان خطة لجذب الزبائن لمتجر هدايا في غير موسم الأعياد، ويحاول مساعدة حديقة حيوانات أليفة من خلال جعل أحد خنازيرها "بطلاً" مشهوراً على الإنترنت

3.o: يقدم ناثان حلاً لمتجر ملابس يعاني من السرقة عبر السماح للزبائن "الجذابين" فقط بالسرقة، ويحاول مساعدة مطعم من خلال الترويج لاستخدام حماماته للعامة.

4.o: يبتكر ناثان أغرب نظام خصومات في العالم بمحطة وقود، ويساعد رسام كاريكاتير على تغيير أسلوبه ليصبح "الرسام الأكثر قسوة" في المدينة

5.o: يحاول ناثان جعل منزل مسكون أكثر رعباً عبر تهديد الزبائن بشيء حقيقي، ويساعد فندقاً في استقطاب العائلات من خلال خطة تسمح للآباء بالاستمتاع بوقتهم الخاص

6.ar: دار الجنازات / متجر البرجر / القفز بالمظلات
6.o: يقدم ناثان خطة تسويقية لدار جنازات متعثرة، ويختبر ولاء الزبائن في مطعم برجر محلي من خلال جهاز كشف الكذب

7.o: في هذه الحلقة الخاصة، يضع ناثان حياته وسمعته على المحك؛ حيث يجب عليه الهروب من أصفاد حديدية قبل أن تقوم ذراع آلية بنزع ملابسه أمام جمهور من الأطفال، مما قد يجعله يواجه عواقب قانونية وخيمة

8.o: يختبر ناثان مهارات محقق خاص من خلال محاولة التفوق عليه، ويقدم نظام "التاكسي الصامت" لمساعدة الركاب الذين لا يفضلون الدردشة مع السائقين

1.o: يُقنع ناثان صاحب ورشة ميكانيكا بتقديم عرض "كشف كذب" لضمان أمانة الفواتير، ويساعد سمسارة عقارات في تسويق نفسها بصفتها "الوكيلة التي لا تخاف من المنازل المسكونة"

2.o: لزيادة مبيعات متجر هدايا تذكارية، يستعين ناثان بشبيه لـ "جوني ديب" لتصوير فيلم وهمي، وينتهي به الأمر بإنشاء مهرجان سينمائي كامل ليجعل الخطة قانونية

3.o: يصمم ناثان ضريحاً ضخماً للحيوانات الأليفة لجذب الزبائن لمتجر محلي، ويحاول تسريع خدمة تنظيف المنازل من خلال توظيف جيش من المنظفين للعمل دفعة واحدة

4.ar: متجر مشروبات كحولية / شركة مكافحة حشرات / مغسلة سيارات
4.o: يساعد ناثان متجر خمور في البيع لزبائن تحت السن القانوني (عن طريق خطة ذكية للاحتفاظ بالمشتريات حتى يبلغوا السن). يقوم خبير إبادة حشرات بعمله بمنتهى السرية والكتمان

5.o: يستخدم ناثان قانون المحاكاة الساخرة  لافتتاح مقهى مطابق تماماً لـ "ستاربكس" في علامته التجارية ومظهره، تحت مسمى ستاربكس الغبي

6.o: يبتكر ناثان نظاماً لحماية السيدات في المواعيد الغرامية الأولى، ويقترح برنامجاً جذرياً وجديداً لإنقاص الوزن، كما يساعد منظمة حفلات في تقليل "قلق قائمة الضيوف" لدى عملائها

7.o: يبتكر ناثان طريقة لمنح شركة سيارات أجرة متعثرة بعض التغطية الإعلامية التي تشتد الحاجة إليها، كما يطبق سياسة جديدة ومحفوفة بالمخاطر لتجاوز الطوابير في كشك لبيع "الهوت دوغ"

8.o: يُسوق ناثان للعبة أطفال غير جذابة، ويبتكر وسيلة لإحراج الأشخاص الذين يتشاركون وجباتهم الخفيفة في السينما، كما يعرض فكرة برنامج واقعي بطله "سايمون" حارس الأمن

1.o: يصطدم ناثان بشركة عملاقة عندما يحاول مساعدة متجر إلكترونيات متعثر

2.o: يبتكر ناثان طريقة تسمح لمزرعة خيول باستقبال الدراجين الذين يعانون من زيادة الوزن؛ ويحاول متجر ملابس نسائي إرضاء الزبائن من الرجال عبر إنشاء "منطقة للرجال" ؛ وبعد اكتشافه أن الشركة المصنعة لسترته قد نشرت تحية لـ "دوغ كولينز" (المتهم بإنكار الهولوكوست) في كتالوجها، يؤسس ناثان شركة ملابس خاصة به تهدف للتوعية بـ "الهولوكوست"

3.o: يوفر ناثان عمالة مجانية لشركة نقل أثاث من خلال ابتكار هوس رياضي جديد يُعرف باسم "الحركة"

4.o: يساعد ناثان متجراً للأدوات الرياضية يعاني من الركود عبر تجنيد رياضيين شباب واعدين للترويج للعلامة التجارية؛ كما يساعد متجراً للتحف على زيادة إيراداته من خلال فتحه على مدار 24 ساعة يومياً، وذلك لاستدراج الزبائن (السكارى ليلاً) لانتهاك قاعدة "إذا كسرته، فعليك شراؤه"

5.o: يكتشف ناثان أنه يستطيع السماح بالتدخين داخل إحدى الحانات إذا قدم الأمر على أنه "مسرحية" أمام جمهور مكون من شخصين؛ ثم يقوم ناثان بإعادة تمثيل المشاهد (التي حدثت في الحانة) كعرض مسرحي حقيقي

6.o: يسوق فندق لنفسه باستهداف الآباء الذين يتمتعون بحياة جنسية نشطة؛ ويركز وكيل سفريات على العملاء من كبار السن. كما يشارك ناثان حله الخاص لمشكلة التأخر عن المواعيد

7.o: تتعثر خطة ناثان لحماية طلاء أظافر السيدات من التقشر وتأخذ منحىً خاطئاً، كما يواجه ناثان أسوأ عيب في شخصيته ويحاول معالجته

8.o: ينتحل ناثان شخصية رجل آخر في محاولة لتحويله إلى بطل إنساني (عن طريق تنفيذ عملية إنقاذ جريئة عبر السير على حبل مشدود بين مبنيين)

1.o: ينظم ناثان خدعة متقنة لجعل الأمر يبدو وكأن الكوميدي مايكل ريتشاردز قد ترك بقشيشاً بقيمة 10,000 دولار في أحد المطاعم

2.ar: محل لبيع الفلفل الحار / صالون تدليك
2.o: يبتكر ناثان طريقة لبيع "التشيلي" (الفلفل الحار) بشكل سري، ويؤسس جمعية خيرية لمساعدة صالون تدليك على إقناع عملائه بشراء خدمات إضافية بسعر أعلى

3.o: يعود ناثان للتعاون مع عميل قديم لتجنيد عدد من سائقي سيارات الأجرة الساخطين، وذلك ضمن خطة تهدف لتخريب أعمال شركة "أوبر" من الداخل

4.o: يصقل ناثان مهاراته في سرد القصص

5.o: يعلم ناثان مصدراً دولياً كيفية شحن أجهزة إنذار الدخان دون دفع ضرائب

6.o: يساعد ناثان محل إصلاح حواسيب في كسب ثقة الجمهور، وتأخذ الاستراتيجية التسويقية منحىً شخصياً جداً بالنسبة لعرّاف

7.o: يحاول ناثان مساعدة شبيه بيل غيتس في العثور على حبه القديم الذي فقده منذ زمن طويل ولم الشمل بينهما

1.o: بعد تحطم قلبه نتيجة وفاة أحد أحبّائه، ينضمّ "كايا" لوحدة شرطة خاصة وهي تتعامل مع تداعيات حادث إطلاق النار الدموي الأخير في مدرسة "ديار بكر".

2.o: تشرع الوحدة في تسليم قيادي حزب العمال الكردستاني الأسير وسط صدامات دائمة قرب الحدود السوريّة، لكنّها تواجه كمينًا في الطريق إلى "ماردين".

3.o: يُحاصَر "توران" و"كايا" بين الحطام خلال عمليّة خطيرة في "سور"، فيجد "مورات" طريقةً لإنقاذهما بمساعدة "غوتشه"، ولكنّه يُخاطر بحياته.

4.o: يهجم الفريق على مقهًى في "إسطنبول" مرتبط بشبكة تهريب، ويتتبّع رجلًا مطلوبًا معروفًا بـ"الشبح"، بينما تعثر "أسينا" على رسالة من والدها.

5.o: ينخرط "توران" و"كايا" في خطّة مع "عثمان" لإخراج أعداء مختبئين، بينما يستجوب "كمال" عامل هواتف أجنبيًّا للمساعدة في إحباط مؤامرة وشيكة.

6.o: عندما يحتجز مسلّحون رهائن مدنيّين داخل مبنًى، ينتهز "كايا" الفرصة للانتقام لمقتل أخته. ويتوقّع "تورغوت" حدوث عاصفة سياسيّة كبيرة.

1.o: تقابل "تشا سو هيون" "كيم جين هيوك"، وهو سائح تقضي أمسية رومانسية غير مخطّط لها معه في أرجاء المدينة أثناء تواجدها في "هافانا" خلال رحلة عمل.

2.o: تبحث "سو هيون" في ملفّ "جين هيوك" بعد معرفتها أنّه موظّف جديد في فندقها. وفي وقت لاحق، تقترح عليه تناول وجبة معًا.

3.o: بعد أن تتصدّر صور لها مع "جين هيوك" عناوين الأخبار، تطلب "سو هيون" من "جونغ وو سيوك" التحدّث إلى أمّه المتطفّلة.

4.t: That's Why I'm Trying to Stop
4.o: تظهر "جانغ مي جين" في الحيّ الذي يسكن فيه "جين هيوك" حاملةً رسالة، ويهدّد منشور كاذب على الإنترنت بتأليب موظّفي "سو هيون" ضدّها.

5.o: من أجل حماية "سو هيون"، يتّخذ "جين هيوك" موقفًا جريئًا أمام زملائهما، ثمّ يتغيّبان عن العمل للاستمتاع بقضاء فترة ما بعد الظهيرة معًا.

6.o: تضع "سو هيون" و"جين هيوك" مُسمًّى لعلاقتهما. وفي يوم افتتاح فندق جديد، تُمطر "كيم هوا جين" "جين هيوك" بكلمات جارحة.

7.o: يُلقي تصريح "سو هيون" الشجاع للجميع بعواقبه عليها وعلى "جين هيوك"، وتطلب "جو هيي إين" من "جين هيوك" أن يتوخّى الحذر.

8.o: يودّع "جين هيوك" و"سو هيون" بعضهما مؤقّتًا حين يُنقَل إلى مكتب آخر. وفي الفندق، يبدأ العام الجديد بحفل تنكّري راقص.

9.o: بعد الكشف عن هويّته كحبيب "سو هيون"، يواجه "جين هيوك" تحدّيات جديدة، بينما يتقدّم "وو سيوك" إليها بعرض محرّك للمشاعر.

10.t: It Proves That I Was the First to like You
10.o: تواجه جهود "سو هيون" لشراء عقارٍ خطرًا بعد ظهور مؤامرة تهدف إلى تقويض موقفها. ولتحسين الوضع، يحجز "جين هيوك" تذكرة طائرة للعودة إلى "كوبا".

11.t: My Heart Is Full of You
11.o: يعود "جين هيوك" إلى المكتب في "سول" بينما تبحث "سو هيون" عن إجابات، ويُرسل "وو سيوك" مقطع فيديو فيه دليل إدانة لمساعد والدته.

12.o: يعزم "وو سيوك" على أن تسير الأمور كما يريد، فينصّب نفسه الرئيس التنفيذي المساعد للفندق، ويجب على "سو هيون" أن تختار بين نداء الواجب والقلب.

13.t: I Can No Longer Live Without You
13.o: يعوق اعتراف مفاجئ عملية تصويت مجلس إدارة الشركة. وفي هذه الأثناء، لا يروق لكلّ أفراد عائلة "جين هيوك" مواعدته لـ"سو هيون".

14.o: تشعر "سو هيون" بتخبّط حيال مستقبل علاقتها مع "جين هيوك". وعلى صعيد آخر، يتّخذ والدها خطوة غير متوقّعة بشأن مسيرته المهنية السياسية.

15.o: في هذه الحلقة، تعتقد "سو هيون" أنّ الصواب هو إنهاء علاقتها بـ"جين هيوك"، الذي يتحطّم فؤاده ويشقّ عليه استيعاب قرارها.

16.o: يفعل والد "سو هيون" كلّ ما في وسعه ليخلّص ابنته تمامًا من قبضة مجموعة "تايغيونغ"، ويجهّز "جين هيوك" هديةً تحمل مغزًى لإهدائها إلى "سو هيون".

1.o: Daphne is in a coma after a fall. Her mother, best friend, and sister-in-law are patiently watching over her. But her brother and her ex-lover are in a hurry ...

2.o: Just as her family was about to unplug her, Daphnée opens her eyes. While some people want to understand, others fear that she'll remember too much.

3.o: Daphnée's loft has been robbed. While her family tries to decide who will take her in, Daphnée discovers something that rules out her suicide theory.

4.o: Daphnée's theory outrages Adrien. Determined to get to the bottom of it, she keeps searching. So many secrets...will Daphnée her cards right?

5.o: Daphnée is more certain than ever that her fall was provoked. Tristan looks into it and his findings corroborate Daphnée's dark premonition.

6.o: Tensions are running high in the family. Daphne is racking her brains trying to remember, but the important details elude her. How far will she go to discover the troubling truth?

1.o: في إطار كوميدي لايت تدور الأحداث حول العرضحالجي سراج الذي يعمل أمام المحكمة، ووقوعه في العديد من المشاكل والمفارقات الكوميدية.
يبدو الغرب وكأنه العالم كله للذين يعيشون هناك. وأصبح عالمًا جديدًا عند وصول الأوروبيين، عالمٌ تعرض لهزة بسبب الرؤى المتعارضة.

2.o: مجموعة من الأمريكيين يتجهون غربًا عبر ممرات، يتتبعون تجارة الفراء، والقتال من أجل تقرير المصير أو بحثًا عن الحرية الدينية أو حياة أفضل.

3.o: تأتي حمى التهافت على الذهب بالعالم كله إلى الغرب. عمال مناجم من آسيا وأمريكا الجنوبية والولايات الشرقية يتسابقون للحصول على “حصة من الصخور”.

4.o: تأتي الحرب الأهلية مبكرةً إلى الغرب. يحارب مناهضو العبودية في “كانساس” لتحرير الأرض، وتزحف القوات الاتحادية إلى “يوتا” لمواجهة المورمون.

1.o: Falsely accused, Lucinda Price is sent to a strange reform school where she meets intriguing Daniel, who believes they've met before, and Cam, who claims to know why she's really there. Unsettled, Luce doubts her sanity and tries to flee.

2.o: Reeling from her punishment in solitary and troubled by the Shadows, Luce questions her memory of what happened when she tried to run away. Disturbing memories of hurting Cam haunt her and she sets out to retrieve his medical records to find the truth. Daniel, shattered from his own severe punishment, refuses to assist with Luce's plan, but when she gets into trouble, he steps in. Luce manages to get the medical data out of the facility for decryption, but she's left with a single photograph that shocks-it's a glimpse into Daniel's impossible past.

3.o: Cassie, the only person to escape Sword and Cross, is confronted by a nightmarish creature. Luce suspects that Howson is controlling their memories-she steals photographs of her and other residents undergoing a medical procedure that they don't remember having. The residents are sent on a hike while Howson orders Cassie be brought to Sword and Cross. Daniel and Luce grow closer trying to work out their hidden past. When something attacks Luce in the lake, Luce and Daniel are taken to the medical bay-they break into a restricted room and are shocked by what they find.

4.o: Howson organises the capture of the creature that attacked Luce in the lake and interrogates it-establishing it is an Outcast, an ancient creature with a hive mind. Luce comforts Daniel over his grief for his friend, Cassie while they await the return of the decrypted medical files. Learning that the files will be returned during an evening activity, Luce tries to work out how to sneak away to collect them. Salvation comes when Penn's father turns up at the facility, looking for answers about his 'dead' daughter. Luce and Daniel retrieve their files, but the content turns their world upside do

5.o: Daniel has been in the facility for over twenty years - but hasn't aged. It is the same story for the other residents - and worse, Howson has been running experiments on them, suppressing their memories to keep them trapped. Luce and Daniel plan to break out of the facility to alert the authorities, but their escape is cut short - Howson has been tipped off. As they try to work out who betrayed them, the Outcast escapes and injures Daniel, chasing them through the facility. Desperate to save Daniel, Luce tries to find sanctuary but discovers a shocking secret instead.

6.t: Six Characters in Search of an Exit
6.o: Miss Miriam initiates a desperate hunt for the Outcast while Howson tries to save Daniel's life. Luce, Cam and the other residents try to make their way to safety, but the creature pursues them, leaving a trail of death in its wake. Luce discovers the identity of the person who leaked their escape attempt to Howson. Meanwhile, Daniel fades on the operating table; unconscious, he relives his time with Luce in a past life. As life slips away from Daniel, Luce fights her way back to the medical bay to reach him and save his life.

7.o: Miss Miriam reveals some of Sword and Cross's secrets to the residents. As they reel from the revelations, Luce has her own issues. Daniel has rejected her, worried that she will be cursed to die an early death if she stays with him. Furthermore, the Shadows have shown her a vision of Penn's death, and she struggles to figure out what it means. When Luce and Daniel learn that Penn is planning to leave to find her father-Luce talks her into staying for her own safety. But Penn breaks her promise.

8.o: Mourning Penn's death, Luce believes it was murder. The residents work together to get answers. Daniel confronts Miss Miriam, Cam confronts Howson, and Luce confronts Miss Sophia, who traps Luce in the library and sets it ablaze. Daniel rushes to help Luce escape, and the pair are reconciled. But Miss Sophia won't give up; she kidnaps Luce and drags her to a sacred altar in the woods. With Outcasts overrunning the facility, Daniel and the other residents fight their way to the woods to find Luce and become trapped in an epic showdown.
